Hi! For a bulk import you’ll need at least the following headers in your CSV:

* **email** – the contact’s email address
* **name** – the contact’s full name
* **company** – the company the contact belongs to

You can also include optional columns such as **phone**, **title**, or any custom field that already exists in your workspace – just use the exact field name. The importer matches columns by header name, not by position, so the order doesn’t matter. Any extra columns that aren’t recognised will be ignored. If you want to be 100 % sure of the exact spelling, download the sample template from the import screen. Let me know if you need help preparing the file!
